Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Aquila Analytics MAP kickoff / technical owners & evaluation cadence

Hi Priya and Daniel —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, I want to get a short mutual action plan (MAP) started so we have clear owners and a realistic close/eval timeline. I’ve looped in two folks from the technical side at Redwood: Karthik (Solutions Engineer) and Rishi (ML Engineer).

High level proposal (first pass):
- Week 1 (this week): technical kickoff and data/connectivity checklist
- Week 2: test workload run + baseline latency/cost metrics
- Week 3: model tuning/quantization trial and perf comparison
- Week 4: decision window / procurement conversations

Please confirm the right technical owner on your side (I’ve put Priya as eng lead and Daniel as product lead) and let us know any must-have evaluation criteria (throughput SLA, P99 latency target, dataset size limits, redaction/PII requirements). I attached a short MAP draft (Aquila-MAP-v1.pdf) and our security summary.

Proposed next step: 30-minute technical kickoff on Wednesday 10–10:30 PT. If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and an agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com | M: (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Aquila Analytics MAP kickoff / technical owners & evaluation cadence

Evelyn —

Thanks, this looks good as a starting point. Confirming that I’m the engineering lead on our side and will own the data connector and onboarding work. Daniel will own product acceptance criteria (we care about latency at 95th for the batch API and P99 for real-time).

A couple of priorities from Aquila:
- Must validate inference within our VPC (private deployment) and confirm that tokenization behavior is consistent with our existing pipeline.
- Target for eval: <200ms median for typical production prompt (500–800 tokens total) and cost target aligned with your recommendations in the MAP.
- Security Q: we need to see logs retention options and key management for test instances.

Wed 10–10:30 PT works for a quick technical kickoff. Please include steps for the sample workload and any credentials/roles we’ll need to provision.

—Priya
Priya Shah
Senior Engineering Manager, Platform
Aquila Analytics
priya.shah@aquila.ai | +1 (650) 555-0899

Hi Priya / Daniel —

Thanks for confirming. Quick intro: I’m Karthik, Solutions Engineer on the Redwood platform — I’ll drive the technical kickoff and the initial test run. A few operational items I want to flag before the call so we can use the 30 minutes efficiently: 

1) Connectivity: will Aquila provision a temporary VPC peering or an S3 presigned workflow for the sample dataset? If VPC peering, we’ll need the CIDR blocks and a contact to coordinate peering windows.
2) Sample workload: please share a 1–2 GB sample (can be synthetic) and a few representative prompts; include any prompt templating you use.
3) Evaluation metrics: we’ll collect median, 95th and P99 latencies, tokenized length distribution, and cost per 1k tokens. If you have specific queries or throughput targets (reqs/sec), add them to the MAP so we can tune batching.
4) Security: our redwood-security-summary.pdf covers key management (KMS) and audit logs at a high level — if you need an SOC2 artifact or an architecture diagram I can attach it to the follow-up.

Agenda for Wed 10–10:30 PT:
- 10:00–10:05: Intros & roles
- 10:05–10:15: Connectivity and dataset plan (Karthik)
- 10:15–10:22: Evaluation metrics and test harness (Rishi)
- 10:22–10:28: Next steps / calendar for the test run (Evelyn)
- 10:28–10:30: Q&A

I’ve tentatively created a shared drive link for exchange of artifacts (I’ll put it in the calendar invite). Looking forward to the call.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0199
